instructions: Take a look inside this charming book of treats, and you'll find staples like chocolate chip cake and oatmeal raisin bars as well as other favorites such as Cherry Pineapple Bars and Peanut Butter Cupcakes. Featuring an attractive trim size as well as a price that supports impulsive buying and gift giving, this handy cookbook is sure to become a favorite with home bakers. No matter what type of dessert you like to bake, you'll find the perfect treat to make, from cookies and bars to cakes and pies. Best of all, these recipes are shared by real home cooks, and each was tested by a cooking professional at Taste of Home
